title: Attached-session keepalive and detachment
summary: With a controlled disposable QA workspace, checks that fresh session attachment can extend its deadline, while detachment or stale attachment data cannot. Extensions must respect the maximum deadline and recover from a temporary failure.
prerequisites: Q01 passes; QA template actually publishes agent_relay_session_attached at interval under 2m, and relay service account has workspace:update in steven.
Only a disposable QA workspace with an approved controlled deadline/TTL and known maximum deadline is eligible; do not edit production deadlines.
Confirm runner connected, attachment metadata value exactly attached and last successful sample younger than 2m. Record baseline deadline, TTL, max deadline and /extend audit counter if exposed.

Q08-a.fixture: QA-only deadline <=35m from now, TTL and max deadline recorded

Q08-b.fixture: QA-only stale/missing/unattached metadata sample, no production metadata tampering

Q08-c.fixture: QA-only max deadline cap and one scoped transient /extend failure

variants.title: Fresh attachment extends; detach stops extensions
variants.summary: Checks that a freshly attached QA session extends its workspace deadline when eligible, without exceeding its maximum. After detachment, extensions should stop and ordinary workspace expiration should apply.

steps.action: With QA-only deadline control, set recorded workspace deadline within 35m; obtain fresh successful attached sample (<120s old), then poll metadata and deadline every 30s over at least four sweeps.
steps.expected: At least one successful extension moves deadline toward now+45m, unless longer workspace TTL governs or recorded maximum deadline caps it; no past-max extension.
steps.evidence: UTC metadata sample ages, old/new deadlines, TTL/max and sanitized extend result.

steps.action: Detach provider session; verify metadata becomes unattached/stopped, then poll deadline/metadata over at least two metadata intervals plus two sweeps (at least 120s).
steps.expected: No further /extend after detach; workspace follows ordinary TTL/autostop, not perpetual keepalive.
steps.evidence: Detach UTC, metadata values/ages and deadline timeline.

cleanup: Restore QA deadline/TTL controls and end disposable session; verify normal reap or approved targeted cleanup.

variants.title: Stale or missing attachment never extends
variants.summary: With a scoped QA-only fixture, checks each stale, missing, failed or detached session state separately. None should extend the workspace deadline, even when its runner still appears active.

steps.action: Only with scoped QA fixture, produce stale (>120s), missing, failed or unattached metadata separately while deadline lies inside 35m; observe at least two sweeps per state.
steps.expected: No /extend from any nonfresh or non-attached state even if runner status is alive; log each state separately.
steps.evidence: Metadata sample age/status, deadline before/after and sanitized extension counter.

cleanup: Remove scoped metadata fixture and restore QA metadata publishing; confirm healthy fresh samples.

variants.title: Maximum cap and transient extend failure
variants.summary: Checks that deadline extensions for an attached QA session never exceed the approved maximum. With a scoped one-time extension failure, a later eligible attempt should succeed while the QA pool keeps serving.

steps.action: On disposable QA workspace set approved max deadline below now+45m; produce fresh attached metadata and observe next sweeps.
steps.expected: Extension request/result respects max deadline; never exceeds cap.
steps.evidence: Recorded max and observed deadline UTC.

steps.action: Inject one scoped transient /extend failure only on this QA workspace, then remove fault; observe two more sweeps.
steps.expected: Failure is logged and retried on a later eligible sweep; eventual deadline extension remains capped and QA pool keeps serving.
steps.evidence: Sanitized failure/success timestamps and deadline values.

cleanup: Disable fault, restore QA deadline settings and confirm disposable workspace cleanup disposition.

notes: Keepalive depends on attachment evidence, not agent_relay_status alone. A natural autostop may preempt observation; record blocked rather than infer no extension.
Do not use /extend fault fixture without explicit approval for isolated QA workspace.
